sections.h2: How can I sell a house in Vernon Hills?
sections.html:
Owners in Vernon Hills can work with a listing agent, market the house themselves, or accept an as-is offer from a cash buyer. The village does not add its own transfer inspection to any of these, so the timeline depends mostly on the contract, the title work and any repairs you choose to make.

Vernon Hills is a Lake County village of about 7.95 square miles, split between Libertyville and Vernon townships. It incorporated on June 16, 1958, with 123 residents and 125 houses in a single subdivision. The Census Bureau recorded 26,850 residents in 2020 and estimates 26,825 for July 1, 2025, a village that has held steady for several years.

sections.h2: What do Vernon Hills homes and households look like?
sections.html:
Census Bureau figures for 2020 to 2024 show a village of owners with high incomes and values, and a large share of residents born abroad.

  • Homes occupied by their owners: 67.5%
  • Typical value of an owner's home (median): $412,300
  • Median gross rent: $1,903
  • Households: 11,022, averaging 2.43 people
  • Median household income: $121,943
  • Foreign-born residents: 33.6%; language other than English at home: 41.7%
  • Residents age 25 or older with a bachelor's degree or higher: 67.8%
  • Average commute: 26.9 minutes

The median commute of about 27 minutes and the high share of degree holders are the numbers most useful to describe a Vernon Hills listing to out-of-area buyers.

sections.h2: How did Vernon Hills grow into a commercial center?
sections.html:
The land began as a 200-acre farm in 1857, and the Vernon Hills name first appeared on a residential and golf-course development in the 1960s. Annexing a parcel at the corner of Routes 60 and 21 in 1971 led to the 1,200,000-square-foot Hawthorn Center. The village was near 10,000 people by 1980 and past 20,000 by 2000.

Later annexations brought in the Corporate Woods business park, the Centennial Crossing neighborhood, 1,200 acres of Hawthorne-Mellody Farms in 1988 and part of Half Day in 1994. The shopping district called Mellody Farm now stands where a 52-acre soybean field once did. The village's 2021 financial report lists Hawthorn Mall as its largest employer at 2,500 jobs, followed by American Hotel Register, Mitsubishi Electric Automation, CDW and Rust-Oleum. Zebra Technologies is also based in the village.

sections.h2: Which Vernon Hills schools and trains matter to buyers?
sections.html:
The Hawthorn School District serves six grade schools in the village, with Hawthorn Middle School North and Hawthorn Middle School South above them. High school students attend Vernon Hills High School or Libertyville High School. Some southern subdivisions send students to Lincolnshire schools, including Adlai E. Stevenson High School, and the southwest corner uses Long Grove grade schools. Check the school district on your tax bill before you describe the school assignment in a listing.

Vernon Hills has a station on Metra's North Central Service, which runs weekday rush-hour trains between Antioch and Chicago Union Station, and Pace buses also serve the village. Library service comes from two districts: part of the village is in the Cook Memorial Public Library District, with the Aspen Drive Library at 701 N Aspen Drive, and the rest is in the Vernon Area Public Library District. The 184-acre Vernon Hills Athletic Complex, on land once used for a Nike missile base and a naval training center, sits within the village.

sections.h2: Which Vernon Hills repairs need a village permit?
sections.html:
The Community Development Department issues building permits and inspects the work, and its permit page sets out the basics. Doing repairs before a sale is optional, but any permitted work you start should be inspected and closed out so the buyer inherits no open permit.

Vernon Hills residential permit basics
TopicWhat the village says
Review timeTypically 15 business days for residential projects
Quick permitsWater heater, HVAC, roof, siding and sewer repair carry no plan review, released immediately subject to staff availability
PaymentCash or check only
Trade licensesRequired for electricians, roofers and plumbers; the village does not register contractors
Completion bondRequired for most permit types and refunded after final inspections
InspectionsCall (847) 367-3700 at least one day in advance, before 3:00 p.m.

The village also adopted a building code update effective March 1, 2026, through Ordinance 2026-008, and asks applicants to use the current codes even where a form still shows the 2018 edition. Since January 2026, new residential units and substantial renovations also fall under the Electric Vehicle Charging Act, which matters to a buyer who plans to rebuild.

sections.h2: What does Vernon Hills code enforcement look at?
sections.html:
The Community Development Department answers complaints about property maintenance and building code, with tall grass and weeds, debris left in the street and work done without a permit as examples. Complaints go through the village's online service request system or by calling (847) 367-3700. Most vehicle complaints belong with the Police Department.

The department also issues certificates of occupancy for newly occupied units and runs property maintenance inspections, and the permit page links a certificate of occupancy checklist and a pre-inspection checklist. If you are unsure whether a past deck, fence or basement finish was permitted, ask the department before listing, because a buyer's title or lender review can raise the same question.

sections.h2: How is a Vernon Hills property tax bill set, and when is it paid?
sections.html:
Lake County sets Vernon Hills bills on a two-year cycle, so the bill you receive reflects an assessment made the year before. The county's Tax Extension Process page says township assessors value each home as of January 1 at one-third of fair market value, the Chief County Assessor equalizes the values, and a blue assessment notice goes out in the fall. Owners then have only 30 days to appeal to the Board of Review. By the time the bill arrives it is too late to contest it, according to the same page.

For tax year 2025, the county's calendar shows bills mailed May 1, 2026, a first installment due June 4 and a second due September 4. Penalty interest of 1.5% was added the day after each due date, and more accrued in later months. Both dates have passed, and the pattern repeats each year with new dates. A tax sale of delinquent parcels follows in November.

Taxes for the year in progress are usually adjusted between buyer and seller at closing, so get a paid-to-date figure from the Lake County Treasurer before the closing is scheduled.

sections.h2: What do Vernon Hills sellers file at the Lake County Clerk?
sections.html:
Deeds go to the Recording Division of the Lake County Clerk's Office in Waukegan. The county's deed packet requires a notarized grantor signature, the grantee's address, a legal description, the preparer's name and a completed PTAX-203 form or an exemption statement. It also lists six municipalities that require a local transfer stamp before recording; Vernon Hills is not among them, but ask the village clerk if your deed has unusual features.

Under 35 ILCS 200/31-15, the tax is collected through revenue stamps, and paper stamps were to be phased out by December 31, 2025, with electronic stamps or another indicator after that date. Any sale also has to be reported to the Department of Revenue electronically.

faqs.q: Does Vernon Hills require an inspection before I can sell my house?
faqs.a: The village's permit and Community Development pages cover permits, code enforcement and certificates of occupancy for newly occupied units, and none describes a seller inspection tied to a resale. Ask Community Development at (847) 367-3700 if you have open permits or an unusual use.

faqs.q: How long does a Vernon Hills building permit take?
faqs.a: The village says residential permit applications typically take 15 business days to process, with minor permits such as a water heater, HVAC, roof, siding or sewer repair released immediately subject to staff availability.

faqs.q: Do I pay a village transfer tax when I sell in Vernon Hills?
faqs.a: The Lake County deed packet lists six municipalities that require a stamp, and Vernon Hills is not one of them. State and county transfer taxes are collected at recording, so ask your title company for the figures on your deed.

faqs.q: When are Vernon Hills property taxes due?
faqs.a: Lake County bills in two installments, in June and September. For tax year 2025 the due dates were June 4 and September 4, 2026, and bills are mailed at the start of May.

faqs.q: Can a cash buyer close quickly on a Vernon Hills house?
faqs.a: Yes, if the title is clear and the deed and PTAX-203 are ready for Lake County recording. Without a village inspection step, a cash closing depends on the title search, payoff letters and the buyer's funds.
